svg.text: Plot data colours: before and after
Contrast of the plotted mark against that theme’s own plot ground. WCAG floor for a graphical object is 3.0:1.
Tokens read live from the running dev server, not from the stylesheet.
Worst case before: 1.66:1 → worst case after: 3.31:1
Before, the same overlay ranged 1.66:1 to 8.22:1 depending only on which theme was active. After, every mark clears 3:1 on every theme.
series 1 = #4e79a7 (FACIES_PALETTE[0]); series 2 = #b2622d (organic-tokens accent-600), lifted to #f28e2b on dark grounds.
